output.summary: Only COND-02 and test_cond02 really exercise GLOSS.prone. Both agree with the rule but under-assert. The test checks clause #2 (stand-up cost 15 at Speed 30), #3 (grappled, Speed 0, refusal), #5 (Advantage from 5 ft) and #6 (Disadvantage from 40 ft). It never checks #4, the prone creature's own attack Disadvantage, or #1, crawling as the only other movement. It also doesn't test round-down. The other scenarios and tests only apply Prone, or matched on a word or page. The engine's stand_up (combat.py:1702–1709) is consistent. The too-little-movement refusal at line 1709 rests on the stage A gap, and its cost takes the current Speed, rounded down. combat.py:93 and creature.py:538 are not related.
